summary: Official Malaysia/JUPEM cadastral routes were identified, including the MyLand viewer and Terengganu eKadaster, but no safe anonymous parcel identity plus full polygon was verified. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Malay discovery queries and actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-2515-kuala-terengganu.json.
requestOutcomes: MyLand loaded as a public viewer; JUPEM KADASTER metadata was available through indexed service documentation; a Terengganu ArcGIS layer request failed local TLS verification; a direct KADASTER layer request timed out; eKadaster presented a login route. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS disablement were used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [5.33670141494936, 103.114434141764] and population fields were preserved; no coordinate was shifted.
No exact-point hit or miss was obtained, so no parcel-absence inference is made.
Official service metadata and viewer availability do not establish Kuala Terengganu citywide coverage.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no full parcel polygon and stable native identity were verified.
Timeout, login wall, TLS failure, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
